source: Gartling, D.K. (1990) 'A test problem for outflow boundary conditions - flow over a backward-facing step', Int. J. Numer. Meth. Fluids 11, 953-967. Values in step heights as quoted by Barkley, Gomes & Henderson (2002) J. Fluid Mech. 473, 167-190 (Table comparison at Re_Barkley = 600, identical to Gartling Re = 800).
geometry: expansion ratio 2 (S = h), parabolic inlet profile imposed at the step, outlet 30 channel heights (60 S) downstream
